Structural forms

Single: <tag> {name} *bold* (C) -> ... --

Double: <tag> {name} *bold* (C) -> ... --

Triple: raw {name} *bold* (C)

Macro without substitutions: raw {name} *bold* (C)

Numeric reference without substitutions: ©

Individual substitutions

Special characters: <tag> & &#169;

Attributes: Ada *bold*

Quotes: bold italic marked

Replacements: © -> …​ — 

Macros: https://example.com

Post replacements: first
second

Substitution groups

Normal: <tag> Ada bold © https://example.com

Normal quotes before attributes: *attribute bold*

Verbatim: <tag> {name} *bold* (C) <1>

Ordered substitutions

Quotes then attributes: *attribute bold*

Attributes then quotes: attribute bold

Replacements then attributes: (C)

Attributes then replacements: ©

Macros then attributes: https://example.com

Attributes then macros: https://example.com

Escaping

No substitutions: \*literal*

Quotes: *literal*
